name: 01-head-blockers
title: PR #12894 @ 6b2bc23c on a real stack: no Hosted Shell call completes on MySQL
subtitle: MySQL 8.4.7 + Spring jar (Session Store, embedded Broker, publication service) + separate worker processes + packaged Harness; aliyun-sdk-oss 3.18.4 over TLS to a local OSS double
lines: ## B1  Harness/core: the reservation is refused for every Shell call (reproduced on 5a45f62d, cdf056fe, 6b2bc23c: 6/6)
-- POST /internal/managed-tool-publications/v1/.../grants -> 400 invalid_request "The request body is invalid."
== server reason (JDI tap): IllegalArgumentException "Checkpoint does not authorize dispatch"  (ToolPublicationStore.requireCheckpoint)
== latest checkpoint: {"turnId":null,"promptId":null,"phase":"await_runtime","tool":"run_shell_command"}
== hosted-workspace-tool-turn.ts:401 commitAwaitRuntimeBatch(bindings)  -- no turn identity; the relabel lives in open PR #12848
!! command ran 0 times (safe), but the Session is recoveryBlocked=true and its storage lease stays held
## B2  Java, MySQL only: Broker :start -> 500 once B1 is patched (1/1 on each head)
-- POST /executions/<id>:start -> 500 runtime_broker_internal_error
== ClassCastException: LocalDateTime cannot be cast to Timestamp  at ToolPublicationStore.producerBindingLocked:120
== Connector/J 9.7 returns LocalDateTime for DATETIME via queryForMap; H2 returns Timestamp -> unit tests stay green
!! Harness then polls GET /executions/<id> every 100 ms (391 polls in 45 s) for up to 30 min; detach -> 409 while the prompt stays active
== the same method authorizes every producer op (segment/resource/seal/finish), so the whole ingress fails on MySQL
## B3  stdout/stderr seal race -> "Publication is busy" -> blocked, even for `echo hi`   ++ fixed by 5f7a2be5 (6/6 pass after)
## B4  Java, MySQL REPEATABLE READ: long outputs die right after a renewActivation (every 20 s)
-- POST .../segments/stdout/290 -> 500  EmptyResultDataAccessException at ToolPublicationStore.producerBindingLocked:131
== journal_tx rev 9 renewActivation 14:29:02.888 -> segment 290 failed 14:29:02.923; head read FOR UPDATE sees rev 9,
== the plain SELECT on journal_tx uses the older snapshot and misses it
-- 1 GiB, B1+B2 patched:           2/4 blocked (290 and 243 segments kept)
++ 1 GiB, + `FOR SHARE` on :131:   6/6 exact (cdf056fe 4/4, 6b2bc23c 2/2), 0 EmptyResultDataAccessException
note: Unit suites pass at head (core 58, cli 77 locally; CI H2-backed Java jobs green). B1-B4 only appear with the real Harness -> Java -> Broker -> worker chain; B2 and B4 additionally need MySQL (H2 hides them).

name: 02-candidate-green
title: With a 3-file candidate (+33/-4) the O2 durability claims hold on the same stack
subtitle: candidate = B1 turn relabel (ported from #12848) + B2 LocalDateTime conversion + B4 FOR SHARE; runs on cdf056fe and 6b2bc23c; jar/worker/Harness otherwise identical to the head
lines: ## Exact bytes (SQL catalog + stored objects vs an independent SHA-256 oracle)
output                         segments  turn         stdout  stderr   second-owner range reads (head / mid 1.5 MB / tail / zero-length)
++ echo out + echo err (x3)             2   complete     exact   exact    -
++ 100 MiB + 5 MiB, exit 7            105   complete 7s  exact   exact    all 8 exact; past-end, wrong identity rejected; stale writer 409
++ 256 MiB + 1 MiB (B1+B2 only)     257   complete 26s exact   exact    exact
++ 1 GiB + 3 MiB (x7 with B4)      1027   55-93 s      exact   exact    all exact (0/7 blocked; 2/4 blocked without B4)
## Memory (per-PID RSS, 250 ms sampling)
== worker peak 199 MiB @16 MiB, 240 MiB @256 MiB, 224 MiB @1 GiB (+119 MiB)  -> bounded;  JVM 373 -> 759 MiB during 1 GiB (default heap)
## Recovery claims from the Reviewer Test Plan
++ receipt committed, reply withheld, Harness SIGKILLed -> new Harness load 200 after lease expiry (57-59 s)
++   history repaired from the saved receipt, 1 tool.receipt, 1 model continuation, command ran once, ACK to original generation 200
++ lost reply of a segment POST / of finish -> status lookup returns the original receipt; no extra PUT
++ OSS PUT stored but reply lost -> SDK retry -> 409 FileAlreadyExists -> readback verified -> exact (never overwritten)
++ corruption after acceptance -> digest mismatch -> publication quarantined; every later read fails closed (even after bytes restored)
++ bucket versioning Enabled / Suspended -> reads fail closed (500 "cannot enforce immutable objects")
++ quota 507 mid-command -> manifest records quota_exhausted, executionStatus preserved, blocked receipt committed
++ publication service not configured -> 0 executions before refusal
++ file-tool profile regression: author's hosted-workspace-tool-turn-driver passes on 6b2bc23c + MySQL (6.6 s)
== OSS traffic per 1 MiB segment: 1 PUT, 3 full-object GETs (readback + seal + finish), 5 GetBucketVersioning calls
note: The fake OSS implements GetBucketVersioning / GetBucketAcl / PutObject (x-oss-forbid-overwrite) / GetObject and is reached by the PR's own AliyunToolPublicationObjectStore through the real SDK (SigV4, TLS). It is not a real OSS bucket.

name: 03-fault-matrix
title: Fault injection on the candidate stack: what recovers, what bricks the Session
subtitle: worker->Java ingress and Harness->Java owner traffic both pass a fault proxy; OSS faults injected in the OSS double; 6 MiB output unless noted
lines: fault (one occurrence)                                  outcome                                                       Session
++ segment POST processed, reply lost                     status -> SUCCEEDED, exact bytes                              ok
++ finish processed, reply lost                           status -> SUCCEEDED                                           ok
++ OSS PUT 500 / readback GET 500                         SDK retry                                                     ok
++ OSS PUT stored, reply lost                             FileAlreadyExists + readback                                  ok
-- segment POST lost before the server (conn reset)       status of unknown op = 400 -> no retry -> capture failed      blocked
-- segment POST -> 503 once (gateway blip)                same                                                          blocked
!!                                                        command already ran; 2 of 6 segments kept
-- OSS PUT 403 once                                       op left PENDING; worker waits operationTimeout (122 s here)   blocked
!!                                                        with the Shell's pipe paused, then fails
-- /admissions/prepare processed, reply lost              phase FINISHED, admission slot filled, no receipt             permanently
!!                                                        reload -> 409 hosted_turn_recovery_required; 2 MiB held       unrecoverable
-- /receipts/commit processed, reply lost                 in-process detach 503, load 409 already_attached              blocked until
!!                                                        (a Harness restart + lease expiry does recover)               restart
!! output with control chars (binary, \b, \x0b, \x1f)     Java stores Jackson's re-serialisation (\u001F), worker         ok, but ACK
!!                                                        hashes JSON.stringify (\u001f) -> worker marks call unknown   refused 409
!!                                                        10 of 45 terminal envelopes in these runs differ
== all publication refusals surface as 400 invalid_request "The request body is invalid." with nothing logged server-side;
== the Broker maps unexpected exceptions to 500 without logging. B1/B2/B4 were only diagnosable with a JDI exception tap.
note: Design text: "Transient network/service failures may retry within the admitted deadline" and "idempotent admission slot ... content digest and admission command identity remain stable across retries". The worker client re-sends the original request only after a 429; the Harness never retries admission, and its outcome embeds a fresh messageId UUID and timestamp (hosted-workspace-tool-turn.ts acceptShell), so a naive retry could not match the stored slot either.

name: 04-model-view
title: What the model sees from a Hosted Shell call (real qwen3.8-max, candidate stack)
subtitle: ./build.sh prints 3,000 lines (~107 KB) to stdout, then "ERROR: link step failed ..." to stderr and exits 3; prompt: run it once and quote the error
lines: ## functionResponse after a >64 KiB text output
>> Tool output was too large and has been truncated.
>> The full output has been saved to: /Users/<worker>/.qwen/tmp/<hash>/run_shell_command_<id>.output
>> To read the complete output, use the read_file tool with the absolute file path above.
>> ... compiling module 1801 of 3000 ... ok
>> [Output exceeded the maximum captured size of 64.0 KB; captured the first 64.0 KB of 107.4 KB ...]
>> Error: (none)   Exit Code: 3
-- head-only: the stderr error line at the end is not in the model input; the saved file is on the worker disk (65,941 B = head only)
## 8 real-model trials
-- 4 x turn_error  InvalidWorkspaceRelativePathError (whole turn fails; Hosted read_file takes Workspace-relative paths only)
== recorded calls: read_file({"file_path":"/tmp/build_stderr.txt"})
==                 read_file({"file_path":"/Users/<worker>/.qwen/tmp/.../run_shell_command_b2789e1a6a30.output","offset":2990})
++ 3 x complete, error quoted (model redirected stdout/stderr to /tmp and cat-ed them)
!! 1 x complete, error inferred from the script source: "If you want observed proof, I'd need to run it again"
++ build.sh ran at most once in every trial (0 duplicate side effects)
note: Same class as #12848 R1 F1 (fixed there with a head+tail preview). The durable 107 KB capture exists in OSS via manifestRef, but no model-facing tool can read it before O3.
